title: Text Splitting Strategies
summary: This module provides diverse text splitting strategies, including token-based, HTML-aware, and JSON-aware methods, to break down large texts into smaller, manageable chunks while preserving semantic structure or specific formatting.

nodes.label: Tokenize Text
nodes.title: TokenTextSplitter
nodes.description: Splits text into tokens using a specified model tokenizer (e.g., GPT-2), allowing control over special tokens and chunk sizes.

nodes.label: Split HTML by Headers
nodes.title: HTMLHeaderTextSplitter
nodes.description: Divides HTML content into structured documents based on specified header tags (h1, h2, etc.), preserving hierarchical metadata.

nodes.label: Semantically Split HTML
nodes.title: HTMLSemanticPreservingSplitter
nodes.description: Splits HTML content into chunks while preserving semantic structure, converting links/media to Markdown, and optionally performing further recursive splitting.

nodes.label: Split HTML by Sections
nodes.title: HTMLSectionSplitter
nodes.description: Splits HTML files into sections based on specified tags and font sizes, using XSLT for transformation and BeautifulSoup for parsing.

nodes.label: Recursively Split JSON
nodes.title: RecursiveJsonSplitter
nodes.description: Breaks down JSON data into smaller, structured chunks, maintaining the original hierarchy and allowing conversion of lists to dictionaries.

nodes.label: Split Text with spaCy
nodes.title: SpacyTextSplitter
nodes.description: Splits text into sentences or other linguistic units using spaCy's natural language processing pipelines for robust segmentation.

nodes.label: tiktoken library
nodes.title: tiktoken
nodes.description: External library for fast BPE tokenization, used by TokenTextSplitter for encoding and decoding text.

nodes.label: BeautifulSoup library
nodes.title: BeautifulSoup
nodes.description: External library for parsing HTML and XML documents, essential for extracting data from HTML content.

nodes.label: lxml library
nodes.title: lxml
nodes.description: External high-performance XML and HTML processing library, used for XSLT transformations in HTMLSectionSplitter.

nodes.label: NLTK library
nodes.title: NLTK
nodes.description: External Natural Language Toolkit, used by HTMLSemanticPreservingSplitter for optional stopword removal.

nodes.label: spaCy library
nodes.title: spaCy
nodes.description: External industrial-strength natural language processing library, providing advanced text segmentation capabilities.

nodes.label: Recursive Character Splitter
nodes.title: RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter
nodes.description: A general-purpose text splitter that recursively splits text by a list of characters, used for fine-grained chunking by other splitters.

nodes.label: Document Object
nodes.title: Document
nodes.description: Standard data structure representing a piece of text content along with associated metadata, used as output by splitters.

groups.label: HTML Content Splitters
groups.title: HTML Content Splitters
groups.description: Components designed to parse and split HTML documents based on their structural and semantic properties.

groups.label: Specialized Text/Data Splitters
groups.title: Specialized Text/Data Splitters
groups.description: Components for splitting specific data formats like tokens or JSON, or using advanced NLP techniques.

groups.label: External Libraries
groups.title: External Libraries
groups.description: Third-party libraries that provide core functionalities for parsing, tokenization, and NLP.
